title: 3-Phase BL0906 Energy Metering Schematic
desc:
I need a complete schematic that lets the BL0906 energy-meter IC into a three-phase design and talk to it through a standalone STM32F103CBT6. The STM32 only has one job: grab raw registers from the BL0906, crunch RMS voltage and current, active power, active energy, fault flags and line frequency, then pass the results to my main controller (an ESP32) over SPI, which is the fixed interface for this project.

Key electrical details
• Current input must accept either conventional CTs or voltage-output sensors through a jumper-selectable.
• Voltage sensing is handled by a ZMPT101B module.  
• I want a well-calibrated passive filter stage on every phase to tame mains transients and high-frequency noise before they reach the BL0906. Keep the cut-off practical for 50/60 Hz metering accuracy while giving good surge immunity.
• Calibration option required for accuracy.

What I expect from you
• A clear, production-ready schematic (PDF + editable file in KiCad ).  
• Annotated BOM with part numbers that are easy to source.  
• Brief design notes explaining CT burden selection, jumper logic and the passive filter design so I can tweak values if my sensor mix changes later.

I’m building a steady stream of tasks that need to become crisp, persuasive copy. To do that, I want to partner with a skilled writer—specifically someone who lives and breathes copywriting.  

Expect to work on short-form and mid-length pieces such as landing pages, ad headlines, product blurbs, and email sequences. Turnaround can be fast, so the ability to absorb a brief quickly, ask sharp questions, and deliver clean, engaging text on schedule is essential. Google Docs (or a comparable cloud editor) will be our shared workspace; familiarity with basic on-page SEO and CTA placement is a plus, though not mandatory.  

Deliverables  
• Finished copy for each assigned task, ready to publish  
• Up to two revision rounds per piece  
• Final text supplied as shared Google Doc links with clear file names  

To start the conversation, please send two recent samples that demonstrate your knack for conversion-focused writing and include a note on how long you typically need for a 300-word assignment. I’ll set up individual milestones for each new brief so both of us stay clear on scope, timeline, and payment.  

Looking forward to seeing how your words can lift these projects.

title: 6-Lane Pier Table Reinforcement BBS -- 3
desc:
6-Lane Pier Table BBS

* Preparation of **Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) for 6-lane pier table reinforcement** based on approved structural drawings and reinforcement details.
* The freelancer shall prepare **accurate cutting lengths, bar marks, bar diameters, spacing, shape codes, quantities, unit weights and total steel quantities** for all pier table reinforcement.
* BBS shall cover **bottom/top reinforcement, longitudinal and transverse reinforcement, distribution bars, extra/anchorage reinforcement, U-bars, chairs and other reinforcement as detailed in the drawings**.
* The BBS shall be prepared in **Excel format**, properly cross-checked with drawings and suitable for **site execution, bar cutting, bending and quantity reconciliation**.
* Freelancer shall coordinate with the site/structural team for **clarifications and corrections** and submit the final BBS after incorporating all comments.
* **High accuracy is mandatory**, as the BBS will be directly used for reinforcement fabrication and site execution.

title: Patronista Lencería y Corsetería Creativa
desc:
Necesito un patronista con experiencia real tanto en lencería como en corsetería. El objetivo es transformar mi colección de referencia —te haré llegar un set de imágenes que ilustran líneas, detalles y acabados— en patrones digitales listos para producción.

Requisitos técnicos: Desarrollo de moldería base y escalado enfocado en calce anatómico y ergonomía (priorizando el ajuste en cuerpos reales y no en tablas genéricas rígidas). Valoro que domines software de patronaje (CLO, Optitex, Lectra o similar) y que sepas preparar archivos en formatos compatibles con láser/plotter.

Muéstrame piezas anteriores; con ver tus patrones terminados o fotos del producto final me basta para evaluar tu estilo y precisión. No necesito propuestas extensas, solo evidencias de que ya has desarrollado lencería y corsés que encajen bien, mantengan soporte y luzcan limpios en confección.

Inicio del proyecto:
Tan pronto cerremos el acuerdo, te entregaré las imágenes de inspiración y el estilo de prendas que busco. El/la patronista seleccionado/a desarrollará o adaptará la tabla de medidas ergonómica, además de calcular los porcentajes de elasticidad según los materiales e insumos previstos.

Entregables requeridos:
• Patrones digitales en PDF/A0 y DXF  
• Ficha técnica breve con indicaciones de montaje y consumos 
• Moldería base y escalado completo: Desarrollo del patrón inicial y graduación técnica en 4 tallas (S, M, L y XL) por cada modelo, garantizando la proporción y el calce anatómico en cad

title: German 15-Minute Scripted Discussion
desc:
I need native German speakers to read a short, pre-written script that runs for roughly fifteen minutes. 

I will supply the full script in advance so you have time to get comfortable with the wording and flow; the goal is to sound natural, as though you are chatting spontaneously even though the lines are provided. 

If you are a native speaker with a clear accent and can record in a quiet space, I’d love to hear a short voice sample and your earliest availability.

title: Tech Website Content Developer
desc:
I run a US staffing company with several customer-facing sites, and I need fresh website copy that gives visitors crystal-clear, in-depth information about each of ourservices. The goal is to replace the placeholder text we currently have with authoritative, engaging content that speaks both to technical buyers and to non-technical decision makers.

You will be writing full web pages rather than short blog pieces. Each page must:  
• Explain what the service we do, how it works, and the problems it solves  
• Highlight key specifications in plain language without losing technical accuracy  
• Encourage action through a concise yet persuasive tone

Because these pages are central to our sales funnel, accuracy is critical. I will provide product briefs, datasheets, and access to our engineers so you can verify every detail. Familiarity with common tech industry terminology, SaaS models, and B2B tone will help you excel.

Deliverables:  
• Draft copy for the homepage and the main product pages (approx. 6–8 pages, 500–700 words each)  
• A short meta description for each page to support on-page SEO  
• One revision round per page after internal review

Please share your tech website content portfolio

title: Fotógrafo de Productos para E-commerce
desc:
Necesitamos contratar a un fotógrafo de productos ubicado en Santiago de Chile para realizar una sesión fotográfica destinada a nuestro e-commerce. Los productos pertenecen a la industria de alimentos y bebidas, principalmente productos similares a los que se exhiben en góndolas de supermercado. En nuestro caso, se trata especialmente de café envasado y accesorios relacionados.

El trabajo consiste en:

- Tomar fotografías profesionales de nuestros productos.
- Editar y retocar las imágenes.
- Entregar las fotografías listas para publicar en una tienda online, con buena iluminación, colores fieles y fondo adecuado para e-commerce.
- Entregar los archivos finales en alta calidad y en formato optimizado para web.

No es necesario que el fotógrafo cuente con estudio propio, ya que disponemos de un espacio en Santiago donde se puede realizar la sesión. El profesional deberá contar con su propio equipo fotográfico y, de ser necesario, elementos de iluminación y fondo.

Si el fotógrafo dispone de un estudio o espacio propio, también podemos evaluar realizar la sesión allí. Ambas modalidades son viables y serán consideradas según las propuestas recibidas.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en fotografía de productos, idealmente con trabajos previos para e-commerce.

Al postular, agradeceremos indicar:

- Valor del servicio.
- Cantidad de fotografías o productos incluidos.
- Plazo de entrega.
- Disponibilidad.
- Si cuenta con estudio propio o prefiere trabajar en nuestro espacio.

title: Mixed Data Entry From PDFs
desc:
I have a collection of PDF files that contain a blend of text and numerical information. I need every field from these digital documents keyed into a clean, structured template that I will supply before we start. Accuracy is critical—names, figures, dates, and any descriptive notes must match the source exactly, with the original layout reflected logically in the new sheet.

You’ll work directly from the PDFs, so confidence using PDF readers, quick-look shortcuts, or copy-paste tools (where possible) will help. If any characters fail to render or numbers appear ambiguous, flag them so I can clarify rather than guessing.

When the last file is complete, simply return the filled template along with a brief note confirming any items you had to verify. That’s it—straightforward, detail-focused data entry from PDF to my preferred format.

title: Accurate Word Data Entry
desc:
I have several documents that need to be transcribed into a single, clean Microsoft Word file. The source material will arrive in mixed formats—scanned pages, digital PDFs, and the occasional handwritten note—and I simply need the contents reproduced faithfully.  

Stick to straightforward text formatting: clear paragraphs, matching headings where they naturally appear, and consistent spacing. No custom templates or advanced layout work is required; accuracy and a tidy, error-free .docx are what matter most.  

If you have an eye for detail, solid typing speed, and can turn the work around promptly, let’s get started.

title: PhD Qualitative Data Analysis
desc:
I'm seeking an experienced data analyst to assist with my PhD research. The project involves analyzing qualitative data using SPSS.

Key Requirements:
- Analyze qualitative data
- Perform descriptive and regression analysis
- Deliver insights and detailed reports

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Expertise in SPSS
- Strong background in qualitative data analysis
- Experience with both descriptive and regression statistics
- Detail-oriented and able to meet deadlines

Please provide samples of previous work and relevant qualifications. Looking forward to your proposals!

title: Word Document Data Entry
desc:
I will supply a batch of digital Word files containing plain text that must be transferred, word-for-word, into the template I provide. Everything is already typed, so the task centres on careful copying, consistent formatting, and a final spell-check to be sure nothing is missed.  
Return the completed template in the same sequence as the original documents and highlight any portions that seem unclear. Accuracy and a quick, reliable turnaround are the only metrics I will use to sign off the job.

title: Video Editing & PDF Extraction
desc:
I have two parallel tasks I’d like handled together. 

First, I’ll be sending over several short marketing clips that need professional editing. We can decide together whether they simply need trimming or something more creative—transitions, text overlays, or colour tweaks—but the end goal is a polished video ready for social posting in MP4.

Second, I need data pulled from a batch of PDF documents and placed into well-structured Excel sheets. The key requirement here is accurate extraction; each field in the PDF must land in the correct column so I can run formulas and pivot tables without further cleanup. The faster you can move from raw PDFs to a tidy Excel workbook, the better.

If you’re comfortable switching between Premiere Pro (or another editor you prefer) and Excel—and you’ve done PDF-to-spreadsheet work before—let’s work out a timeline and get started.

title: Amazon Images & A+ Content Creation
desc:
I am preparing a new Home & Kitchen item for launch on Amazon and need a full set of bright, colorful visuals that put its functionality front and center.  

Deliverables  
• 7 Amazon-ready listing images (primary on pure white, plus lifestyle and infographic shots, 2000 px minimum)  
• 1 short lifestyle video, under 60 seconds, optimized for silent autoplay with on-screen text  
• 10 wide A+ Content banner images  
• 1 looping hero video for the A+ module  

Everything must follow Amazon’s image, ratio, and file-size guidelines. Lifestyle scenes should place the product naturally in a vibrant kitchen setting while highlighting exactly how it works. I will supply raw photos and basic clips; you can add licensed stock or motion graphics as needed.  

Final files should include high-resolution JPEG/PNG for images, 1080p MP4 for video, and the editable PSD/AI and Premiere or After Effects or canva project files so I can tweak them later.  

Acceptance criteria  
• All assets pass Amazon’s uploader checks  
• Consistent brightness, color grading, and typography  
• Clear emphasis on the product’s key functional benefits  

Please show at least one previous Amazon listing or A+ project that uses a similarly bright and colorful style for a Home & Kitchen product to help me evaluate fit.

title: Fresh Produce Wholesale Sales Representative
desc:
I need a results-driven sales representative who can move our fresh produce line into the hands of local wholesale buyers. We farm, pack, and ship a rotating selection of seasonal fruits and vegetables and now want to deepen our presence in local markets, cash-and-carry outlets, and independent grocery chains.  

You should already understand the rhythm of produce buying cycles, know how to speak the language of produce managers, and be comfortable negotiating pallet-level pricing on tight timelines. A solid book of contacts within regional wholesalers or market stall operators will help you hit the ground running; I am ready to supply samples, spec sheets, and pricing grids as soon as you identify interested buyers.  

Deliverables I will use to gauge success:  
• A weekly report summarising approaches made, leads generated, and orders closed  
• Signed purchase orders or clear email confirmations from new wholesale clients  
• Feedback from prospects that can refine our packaging, sizing, or variety mix  

If you are accustomed to walking market floors early in the morning, closing deals on the phone in the afternoon, and keeping meticulous track of volumes and margins, let’s talk.

title: SMS Appointment Setter for UK warm leads
desc:
I run a small local-SEO agency in the UK. My clients are tradespeople - joiners, carpenters, kitchen fitters. I have around 90 warm leads sitting in my CRM who asked about my service and never got a proper follow-up, because I work a full-time job and cannot chase them during the day.

I want one person to work that list by SMS and book qualified prospects into my calendar.

These are warm leads, not cold lists. Every one of them filled in my own Facebook lead form and asked to hear from me. Most have had a message or a video from me already. You are picking up a conversation that started, not starting one from nothing.

WHAT YOU WOULD DO
- Work through my existing CRM list by SMS. I use GoHighLevel and you get a login.
- Qualify against three things: they run a real business, they have a website or a Google Business listing, and they will give me 15 minutes.
- Book them straight into my calendar. The calendar handles its own confirmations and reminders.
- Ring anyone who replies but stalls on picking a time. Voice is the fallback, not the main job.
- Log every attempt in the CRM with the outcome and a dated next step.

WHAT YOU WOULD NOT DO
- No pricing, no pitching, no negotiating. If they ask what it costs, that is my conversation and you hand it to me.
- No audits, no reports, no content, no admin.
- No editing, merging or deleting CRM contacts. Flag anything odd and leave it alone.
- No cold prospecting and no lead sourcing. The list exists.

title: Open  Textbook
desc:
The project is to take an open-access textbook from concept to publication under a permissive Creative Commons licence. The scope begins with shaping a clear table of contents and chapter outlines, followed by drafting the full narrative, worked examples, illustrations, exercises, and reference sections. Accuracy, pedagogical clarity, and consistent tone are essential throughout.

After the manuscript is complete, the work extends to page design and accessibility: clean, responsive typography, navigable headings, alt-text on every figure, and a hyperlinked table of contents. From a single source file (Markdown, LaTeX, or another tool we agree on) the book must export reliably to press-ready PDF, reflowable ePub, and a print-on-demand file set with correct bleed and trim.

Deliverables  
• Structured manuscript with all chapters, end-of-chapter problems, and answer key  
• Source files for text, images, and diagrams, clearly organised for future updates  
• Styled templates or CSS/TeX files that generate identical page numbers across formats  
• Final PDF, ePub, and print-ready files that pass accessibility checkers (e.g., EPUBCheck, PAC 3)  
• A brief build guide so the files can be regenerated by any instructor in the future

Acceptance criteria  
1. Content free of factual errors, plagiarism, and non-licensed assets  
2. Readability score appropriate to the agreed academic level  
3. All links, cross-references, and index entries resolve correctly in each format  
4. Export

title: Multi-Tenant VoIP Platform Development
desc:
I already lease DID numbers from Telnyx and have full access to their SIP, voice, SMS and WhatsApp APIs. Now I need you to turn those raw services into a polished, customer-ready solution that works everywhere—on IP desk phones, on iOS and Android, and through a browser-based portal built for multiple tenants.

Web portal  
The portal must support true multi-tenant separation. Each tenant should manage its own users, assign available numbers, view usage and CDRs, run real-time analytics, and download invoices. A flexible billing engine is essential, with automated invoicing and payment collection as well as dashboards that surface calling, SMS and WhatsApp metrics at a glance.

Mobile apps  
I need companion apps for both iOS and Android. They should register to the same Telnyx back-end so end users can place and receive VoIP calls, send and receive SMS, and handle WhatsApp messaging from their assigned DID, all with push notifications and reliable background VoIP handling.

IP phone compatibility  
Standard SIP phones on the same tenant account must offer identical functionality—high-quality calling plus SMS and WhatsApp message syncing—so an office can move seamlessly between desk phone and mobile.

Primary deliverables  
• Responsive multi-tenant web portal with user management, billing/invoicing, and reporting/analytics  
• Native or high-performance cross-platform apps for iOS & Android providing calling, SMS and WhatsApp features  
• SIP provisioning and documentation s

title: SaaS Marketing Screen Capture Videos
desc:
I need two polished, 90-second videos that market our SaaS platform through crisp, screen-capture–led storytelling. Each piece should feel professional—closer to an Apple-style product walk-through than a casual tutorial—because the primary goal is to convert new visitors who land on our homepage or paid ads.

What the viewer must walk away with:
• A clear sense that the interface is intuitive and visually appealing.  
• Proof that our more advanced capabilities go beyond “nice to have” and solve real pain points.  
• Authentic confidence via short, on-screen customer quotes or quick testimonial snippets.

I can supply raw screen recordings, brand guidelines, and recent customer feedback. You would take it from there: refine the capture flow, add light motion graphics to call out key UI moments, layer in upbeat but unobtrusive music, and handle voice-over or on-screen text that keeps the tone authoritative yet friendly.

Deliverables
1. Two final 90-second MP4 files ready for web and social.
2. Editable project files (Premiere, Final Cut, or After Effects—your choice).
3. Script and simple storyboard for sign-off before full production.

Acceptance criteria: smooth 1080p playback, consistent color grading with our brand palette, readable text at 100% scale, and final approval from our marketing lead.

If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk timing and any extra assets you might need.

• Annotare in un foglio Excel o Google Sheet l'indirizzo email ottenuto, nome del referente se fornito, eventuali note (rifiuto, numero non valido, ecc.).

L’unico scopo è la raccolta dati: non dobbiamo proporre vendite né iscrivere nessuno a campagne marketing, quindi la telefonata può essere molto rapida e diretta.  

Requisiti che preferisco

• Esperienza in telemarketing o customer service telefonico.  
• Precisione nella trascrizione dei dati e rispetto della privacy.  

Consegna

Se hai domande o suggerimenti su come ottimizzare il flusso di lavoro, scrivimi pure: valuto volentieri proposte che facciano risparmiare tempo mantenendo la qualità dei dati raccolti.

title: Descriptions produits technologiques -- 2
desc:
Je souhaite confier la rédaction de descriptions de produits 100 % axées sur la technologie (smartphones, accessoires, objets connectés, etc.). L’objectif est d’obtenir des textes clairs, persuasifs et optimisés pour convaincre les acheteurs en ligne.

title: SolidWorks Parts, Assemblies & Drawings
desc:
I need an experienced SolidWorks designer to turn my concepts into production-ready files. The job centers on modeling a series of simple parts, combining them into a clean, fully-defined assembly that can go straight to manufacturing, and then generating clear 2D drawings.

Here is what matters most to me:  
• Each part model must be parametrically built so later tweaks are painless.  
• The assembly has to reflect real-world fit and tolerances, ready for the shop floor.  
• Drawings should include every detailed view required for machining or fabrication, with rock-solid dimensional accuracy called out.

In addition, a few of the components are light-gauge sheet-metal, so I will need flat patterns and bend tables alongside the standard engineering drawings.

Deliverables  
1. SolidWorks native files (.sldprt, .sldasm, .slddrw).  
2. Neutral formats (STEP for 3D, DWG/PDF for 2D).  
3. Sheet-metal flat patterns where applicable.  

Files are considered complete once dimensions match my supplied specs and the assembly passes an interference check inside SolidWorks. If this fits your expertise, let’s get started.

title: Review GDPR DPA - EU SCCs Module 2, UK IDTA, Art. 28

• What you include in the deliverable set (drawings, renders, material boar

• trim extra spaces or line breaks,
• ensure punctuation is consistent, and
• keep each record in its original row so formulas and references stay intact.

What I expect:  
• A fully automated bootstrap script or Ansible/Terraform playbook that provisions the manager and worker nodes on my Contabo instances.  
• An opinionated but maintainable overlay network, encrypted in-flight, with service discovery and automatic rescheduling of failed containers.  
• Blue/green or rolling update workflow wired into a simple CI/CD step (GitHub Actions is fine) that can automatically roll back if a health-check or readiness probe fails.  
• Centralised logging plus real-time monitoring and alerting—Prometheus + Grafana or another open-source stack that gives me CPU, memory, container health, and custom app metrics with email/Slack alerts.  
• Brief but clear documentation that lets me add new nodes or services without breaking the cluster.

title: Resolve Windows Startup BSOD
desc:
My Windows machine crashes with a blue-screen loop the instant it boots; the stop error shows up before I ever reach the desktop and even Safe Mode drops to the same BSOD. No new hardware or software was added beforehand, so the fault is buried somewhere deeper—in a corrupted driver, system file, boot record, or perhaps a failing registry hive.  

I need a Windows troubleshooting specialist who can remotely isolate the root cause, repair it, and return the system to a normal, clean boot without data loss. The usual toolset—WinDbg, BlueScreenView, SFC/DISM, Driver Verifier, Event Viewer, offline registry edits, and recovery-environment commands—will probably be required, but I am open to any proven workflow you prefer.  

Deliverables  
• Stable boot to normal Windows desktop (and Safe Mode) with no BSOD for at least two consecutive restarts  
• Brief summary report of steps taken and the specific fix implemented so I can reference it in the future  

Once the machine restarts cleanly and the report is in hand, the project is complete.

Please base your analysis on up-to-date trade databases, conversations with suppliers or distributors where possible, and reputable market reports. I’ll use your findings to decide which products to trial, so accuracy and practical detail matter more to me than a huge list of unvetted ideas.

title: PhD Survey Data Collection Analyst
desc:
I am undertaking a PhD study and now need a dedicated research analyst to run both the pilot and the full-scale primary data collection. The project targets academic researchers as respondents and will be carried out entirely through online surveys, so I am looking for someone who is comfortable designing robust instruments that appeal to this audience and who can manage end-to-end digital distribution.

Here is what I have in mind:  
• Refine my draft questionnaire for a small pilot, circulate it, then deliver a concise diagnostic report that highlights response rates, item reliability and any wording issues.  
• Incorporate the agreed adjustments, launch the full survey, monitor incoming data in real time, and keep me posted on response milestones.  
• Export the final dataset (cleaned, coded and ready for analysis) along with a brief methodological note summarising sampling, outreach steps and any limitations encountered.

I already have university ethics clearance; you will simply follow the approved protocol and make sure every respondent receives the consent statement up front. Familiarity with tools such as Qualtrics or Google Forms is helpful, but if you prefer a different online platform let me know—flexibility is fine as long as data security meets standard academic expectations.

If you have a track record of collecting high-quality survey data from scholarly audiences and can start right away, I’d love to hear how you would approach the pilot and timeline.

Please ensure the wording is future-proof enough to accommodate minor feature updates without needing a full legal rewrite.

Deliverables will be accepted when:
• All three documents are delivered in editable Word format plus ready-to-publish PDF.  
• Clauses are properly cross-referenced and free of contradictions.  
• No region-specific references appear unless explicitly required; keep the text globally applicable so I can localise later if needed.

If you have a proven template library or prior experience crafting mobile-first policies, highlight that in your proposal along with an estimated timeline.

title: Modern Lead-Gen Homepage
desc:
I need a single-page homepage designed with a clean, modern, and minimalist look that immediately drives lead generation. The layout should spotlight a concise product/service overview near the top, then flow naturally toward bold, irresistible call-to-action buttons placed above the fold and again near the footer.  

The design must feel spacious, use plenty of white space, rely on a restrained colour palette, and pair sharp typography with subtle motion or micro-interactions to keep the page lively without clutter. Mobile responsiveness is critical; every element—from hero section to final CTA—should adapt elegantly on smaller screens.  

I’m open to Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch for the working file as long as the final deliverable includes:  
• Fully layered editable source file  
• Exported assets ready for development (SVG/PNG as needed)  
• A short style guide covering fonts, colour codes, and button states  

I’ll consider the job complete when the design:  
• Clearly presents our product/service in under 120 words of on-screen copy  
• Features at least two prominent, visually distinct CTA buttons  
• Passes standard accessibility contrast checks  
• Looks perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints  

If you excel at sleek, lead-focused layouts, I’m eager to see your approach and a quick turnaround.

title: Script humoristique vidéo anniversaire
desc:
J’ai préparé une vidéo anniversaire et il me manque le texte qui donnera le ton.  
L’objectif : recevoir un script vidéo entièrement rédigé en français, drôle et rythmé, prêt à être narré ou joué à l’écran.

Contexte  
– Format : vidéo anniversaire, courte (environ 60-90 sec).  
– Public : famille et amis du ou de la fêté(e).  
– Style recherché : résolument humoristique, avec de petites touches d’émotion pour conclure.  

Ce que j’attends exactement  
• Un script structuré scène par scène (ou plan par plan) indiquant dialogues, voix off et suggestions visuelles rapides.  
• Des punchlines faciles à livrer, sans humour privé nécessitant de longues explications.  
• Une chute amusante qui boucle la vidéo et souligne l’anniversaire.  
• Livraison sous format .docx ou .pdf.

Ressources que je fournirai après accord  
– Prénom, âge, traits de personnalité ou anecdotes du/de la fêté(e).  
– Ton des images qui seront montées (photos d’enfance, extraits vidéo, etc.).  
– Toute contrainte de timing ou de voix off.

Critères de réussite  
Le texte doit se lire à voix haute en moins de 90 secondes, susciter au moins trois rires, et rester compréhensible même pour les invités qui ne connaissent pas toutes les anecdotes.

Si vous aimez écrire des punchlines et rythmer des vidéos courtes, votre plume est la bienvenue !

Files arrive in editable Word and occasionally InDesign exports, so familiarity with Word, Adobe Acrobat, or CAT tools such as memoQ/Trados for quicker comparison is welcome, though not mandatory.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Clean, publication-ready Bahasa Melayu and Bahasa Indonesia manuals returned in their original layout.  
2. Glossary provided in Excel or CSV with at least the 200 most frequent terms.  
3. QA report outlining methodology plus any unresolved queries.

title: ANSYS Maxwell Motor Efficiency Analysis
desc:
I need a fast-turnaround electromagnetic FEA study on my “Tab-and-Stab” electric motor concept and have already prepared the full CAD geometry. Scope  
• Set up materials, winding definition, and boundary conditions that match the data I’ll provide.  
• Run efficiency sweeps from light to peak torque, capturing any saturation or flux-leakage effects caused by the tab-and-stab laminations.  
• Return post-processed plots (efficiency maps, torque-speed curves, loss breakdown) plus the *.maxwell or *.aedtz file so I can reproduce the run.

Timeframe  
Everything—model setup, simulation, and concise engineering report—must land in my inbox within 48 hours of award.

Acceptance  
Results must correlate with my baseline back-of-envelope numbers within ±3 % for output power at the rated point, and I’ll verify that the project file runs without errors on ANSYS Maxwell 2023 R2.

If you’re confident you can meet the deadline and accuracy target, let’s get started right away.

• Pulley, idler and roller frame drawings with material specs and weld details  
• Motor-gearbox selection sheet, torque and power calculations, and alignment plan  
• Belt tension, take-up and shaft sizing calculations (CEMA/ISO format)  
• Bill of materials with weight summary for fabrication and transport

I’m fine with whichever design tools you prefer—SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD or similar—as long as the final files are fully editable and dimensionally accurate. If you have questions about loading points, belt speed or guarding, let me know early so we can lock everything down before you start detailing.

The final step is forward-looking insight. Using the newly structured history, create an analysis and forecasting sheet that projects at least the next twelve months and lets me adjust key drivers (growth rate, cost inflation, tax, etc.) to see different scenarios instantly.

• Clean, fully-documented master workbook containing all historic data  
• Three reusable financial report templates linked to that data  
• Interactive forecasting model with adjustable assumptions

I’ll supply high-level prompts about themes and key moments, then give feedback as you refine the script and thumbnails. Once the structure is approved, turn it into a concise handbook (about 15–20 pages) and a companion one-page quick-reference sheet. I have a handful of short, personal text-message sentences written in Yoruba (Nigerian language) that must be rendered into clear, natural-sounding English today. Because they will be presented as evidence of communication, I need the finished work delivered as a PDF that bears an official translator’s stamp to certify its accuracy and integrity.

The scope is small—only a few lines of chat—yet accuracy is crucial. Please handle names, dates and any informal expressions faithfully, keeping the tone intact while conveying precise meaning. Confidentiality is essential; these are private messages.

Deliverables  
• A single PDF containing the English translation, formatted cleanly and stamped with your official translator’s seal.  
• A brief certification statement inside the same PDF confirming you performed the work and that it is a true, complete translation of the original Yoruba text.

Turnaround: same-day completion preferred, so let me know your earliest hand-over time when you respond.

title: Commission Cold Caller: Reverse Mortgage Leads
desc:
I need an experienced, commission-only cold caller to drive highly qualified reverse-mortgage leads. My offer is simple: every lead that meets our underwriting criteria and completes a credit pull pays you $2,000, so your income scales directly with your success.

The goal is to generate qualified leads among seniors aged 62 and above who hold substantial equity and could benefit from a reverse mortgage. Each call must confirm two key points before it is considered billable:  
• the prospect’s genuine interest in a reverse-mortgage solution, and  
• their current mortgage balance, property value, and overall financial position so we can confirm preliminary eligibility.

You will be provided with a brief product outline, compliance guidelines, and the credit-pull authorization form we use inside our CRM. You are free to work your own hours, use your preferred dialer, and refine the script as long as every interaction remains TCPA compliant and results are accurately logged. I track performance weekly through call notes and credit-pull confirmations; payments are released the moment the bureau returns a completed report linked to your lead ID.

This arrangement is ideal for a seasoned phone pro already comfortable speaking with seniors, overcoming objections, and guiding them through a short pre-qualification process. If you are ready to earn uncapped commissions and believe you can consistently deliver credit-pull-ready prospects, let’s talk and get you loaded into the system

title: Malaysian Entry-Level Virtual Assistant
desc:
You will keep my small business organised day-to-day by updating a simple set of books in Excel or Google Sheets and keeping my calendar running smoothly. The workload is genuinely light: record a handful of transactions, note incoming receipts, then arrange or rearrange meetings, send appointment reminders and tick off tasks as they are completed.

We will chat almost entirely through WhatsApp, so you need to be comfortable with fast, informal messaging. Because I’m based in Malaysia and often need same-day responses, I can only consider Malaysian freelancers.

Before we begin, I’d like a short video call to confirm we are a good fit and that your connection is stable.

Deliverables I expect:
• A clean, up-to-date workbook (Excel or Google Sheets) showing all transactions and balances.  
• A current digital calendar with meetings, reminders and task status clearly marked.  
• A brief end-of-week WhatsApp message summarising what was done and any items that need my input.

If you have reliable internet, basic spreadsheet skills and a knack for staying organised, I look forward to meeting you on the interview call.

title: Spanish Writer Needed for Short Content on Wildfires & How Communities Are Responding
desc:
Hi, I’m looking for a native Spanish writer to help turn English materials into clear, natural Spanish about the recent wildfires and how people and communities in Spain are responding.
The focus is practical and human — things like how firefighters, volunteers, and local residents are helping, the emotional side of the situation, and the small ways communities are coming together right now. It should feel real and readable for Spanish readers, not stiff or formal.
Here’s a small example of the kind of text:
English:

Wildfires have forced thousands of people to leave their homes in southern Spain. But even in the middle of the crisis, many communities are coming together. Local volunteers are helping evacuate families, distributing water and supplies, and some families are taking in neighbours who have nowhere else to go. These small acts of solidarity are what people are talking about the most right now.
Please adapt the sample above into natural Spanish in your proposal so I can see your style.
I’m looking for a native Spanish speaker who can write clearly and naturally. 
If the $20 bid fee is a problem, you can apply using the PDF/docs attached to the project.

title: Electrical Power Engineer Needed – Power Quality, Induction Motor, ETAP & Hardware Prototype
desc:
We are a team of Electrical Power Engineering students working on our senior graduation project. We need an experienced Electrical Power Engineer to provide technical guidance and engineering support for designing, simulating, and building a physical prototype.

The project focuses on detecting power-quality disturbances (Voltage Unbalance and Harmonics) affecting a three-phase induction motor, diagnosing the disturbance, and applying automatic corrective actions in a closed-loop system.

Key areas include:
1. Hardware Prototype Development: Guidance on architecture, component selection, electrical design, sensing/isolation, protection, wiring, testing, and troubleshooting for components like three-phase induction motors, VFDs, ESP32-based data acquisition systems, harmonic filters, capacitor banks, and more.
2. Simulation with ETAP: Load Flow Analysis, Harmonic Analysis/THD, Voltage Unbalance scenarios, and comparison between simulation results and physical prototype measurements.
3. Data Analysis/Intelligent Diagnosis: Classification of operating conditions (e.g., normal operation vs disturbances) and implementation of corrective actions with performance evaluation.

Ideal Skills & Experience:
- Expertise in Power Quality | Induction Motors | VFDs | ETAP | Harmonic Analysis | Embedded Systems | Hardware Prototyping
- Practical experience with laboratory/industrial hardware is essential.

Deliverables:
- Technical guidance for hardware design and implementation
- Simulation

title: NZPack NinjaTrader Backtest Setup
desc:

I am interested in performance optimisation rather than mere validation, so I will rely on you to interpret the results, adjust parameter sets, and demonstrate measurable improvements in key metrics such as net profit, drawdown, and Sharpe. When you are satisfied with the numbers, push the optimised settings into a live-ready workspace and double-check order routing, slippage settings, and continuity across sessions.

Deliverables
• Fully functioning NZPack + NinjaTrader installation on my system
• Imported and verified historical gold/silver futures data
• Backtest reports (PDF or Excel) showing before/after performance metrics
• Saved workspace and templates configured for live execution

I will be available on chat for quick questions and can

title: Registered ATO Tax Advisor Needed
desc:
I am an Australian resident and I want a registered ATO tax advisor with advanced expertise to take full responsibility for my personal returns and year-round compliance. The role is ongoing rather than a single consultation, so I need someone who can not only lodge each annual return accurately but also keep me ahead of any legislative changes, deductions, and reporting obligations.  

Typical work will include preparing and lodging my personal tax return, reviewing any investment or employment changes during the year, answering ad-hoc compliance questions, and flagging opportunities or risks well before deadlines. Clear, proactive communication is important to me, as is the ability to translate complex ATO requirements into practical next steps I can act on quickly.  

Deliverables I expect:  
• A fully prepared and lodged personal tax return for each income year  
• Timely compliance advice whenever rules change or new income events occur  
• Brief written summaries of any recommendations or actions required  
• Secure handling of all documents and sensitive data in line with ATO standards  

If you are a registered tax agent who already works comfortably with individual clients and can offer reliable, forward-looking guidance, let’s discuss how we can set up an efficient, long-term arrangement.

title: Pega Case Management Workflow Design and Integration
desc: Looking for an experienced Pega freelancer to design and integrate workflows using Pega 8.x. The initial task will involve a simple 1-hour development task focused on workflow design and integration, including Gen AI features. This is a trial task to assess the freelancer's expertise. If successful, there will be ongoing work for 5-6 months involving pure development tasks. Ideal candidates should have strong experience in Pega case management and workflow design.

desc:

• PowerPoint template (master slides, title, content, closing) styled to match the logo

title: Indian Head Movement Video Collection
desc:
I’m building a dataset to train computer-vision models, and I need recordings from 100 native residents of India performing simple head gestures. Each participant will record a short video in which they:

• Nod up-and-down  
• Shake side-to-side  

A neutral background, steady lighting and the phone held at eye level are all that’s required; no special equipment beyond a standard smartphone camera is necessary. The clip can be silent, rotated in portrait or landscape, and should last roughly 15–20 seconds so both motions are clearly visible.

Deliverables for you:  
1. One MP4 or MOV video per participant labelled with a unique ID.  
2. A brief text file (CSV or XLSX) mapping each ID to age range and gender for diversity tracking.  
3. Written confirmation that all individuals have consented to the data being used for AI-training purposes.

I’ll review submissions within 24 hours of upload; clear, well-lit footage that shows the full head for the entire duration will be accepted immediately. Let me know if you have existing respondent pools or any questions about the recording guidelines.

title: Word Text to Excel Transfer
desc:
I have a collection of Word documents that contain only text, and I need every piece of that content moved into an Excel workbook while keeping the original formatting exactly intact. Paragraph breaks, bullet points, bold or italic emphasis—whatever is on the page now must look the same once it lands in the spreadsheet.

You will receive the Word files as soon as we start. Your job is to create or populate an Excel file so that:

• Each document’s text sits in its own clearly-labeled sheet (or in designated columns/rows if you have a better layout idea).  
• All formatting remains preserved; no auto-stripping to plain text.  
• The final workbook opens cleanly in the latest Microsoft 365 desktop version without warning dialogs or broken styling.

Feel free to use manual entry, VBA, Power Query, or any other method you’re comfortable with—speed is welcome as long as accuracy and formatting integrity are 100 %. Before delivery I’ll spot-check several sections; mismatched fonts, lost bullets, or merged paragraphs will need correction.

title: टेक्स्ट दस्तावेज़ों पर डेटा एंट्री

title: Translate English Legal Docs to Arabic
desc:

• XC8 source code with inline comments  
• Schematic (PDF or PNG) showing the PIC, the lead-acid interface and any protection or regulation stages  
• Bill of materials with part numbers that are in stock at major distributors  
• A brief README explaining build steps, calibration constants and how to extend the code for extra sensors

title: Hyperelastic Material Model for Snap-Through Structure
desc:
Neo-Hookean is suitable as a starting hyperelastic material model for snap-through structure, especially if we are using a TPU/rubber-like material and the strain level is not extremely high.
start with Neo-Hookean for the baseline ANSYS model because it is simple, stable, and easy to calibrate. Then, if my experimental TPU data shows large nonlinear deformation that Neo-Hookean cannot match well, compare it with Mooney–Rivlin or Ogden.

For snap-through analysis, the important point is that the material model must handle large strain + large deformation. Neo-Hookean does this much better than a simple linear elastic model. but 

“A Neo-Hookean hyperelastic material model was initially selected to represent the nonlinear elastic behaviour of the TPU structure under large deformation. The model provides a simple and computationally efficient description suitable for preliminary snap-through analysis. More advanced hyperelastic models, such as Mooney–Rivlin or Ogden, may be considered if greater agreement with experimental material behaviour is required.”

One important limitation: Neo-Hookean alone will not realistically model hysteresis/true energy dissipation. It mainly gives recoverable elastic behaviour. If our final goal is specifically energy dissipation, we eventually need experimental hysteresis data and possibly a visco-hyperelastic or similar dissipative model. For first proving snap-through, though, Neo-Hookean is a very reasonable choice. so lets discuss little bit

title: Acrylic Display Column Assembly - Central New Jersey Locations
desc:
I have several large-diameter acrylic display columns that need to be professionally assembled and bonded so they look seamless from every viewing angle. The sheets have already been cut and rough-shaped; what I require now is a technician who is confident working with thick, clear cast acrylic, solvent cements, and vapor-polish or flame-polish finishing techniques to create museum-grade joins that stay crystal-clear over time.

Because each column is oversized, proper jigging, edge preparation, and stress-free curing are critical. You should already have the clamps, oven or heat-strip equipment for controlled warming of the seams, and the ventilation setup needed for safe adhesive application.

Acceptance criteria  
• Columns stand true and plumb, with no visible bubbles, crazing, or whitening along any bond line.  
• All surfaces remain optically clear after final polish.  
• Final strength supports the specified load test (details provided on award).  
• Units are securely wrapped and ready for freight pick-up.

If you are the person who thrives on perfect acrylic bonds and you have recent photos or references of similar oversized work, let’s talk and schedule a quick call to run through the dimensions and shipping timeline.

Any dialer that lets you hit the volume is fine—your own VoIP soft-phone, a predictive system, even a manual setup—as long as you can prove the calls were made. At the end of each day I’ll need two concrete deliverables:  

• A CSV (or Google Sheet) with the respondent’s answers and time-stamp for each completed survey  
• An export of the call log showing total dials, connection rate and call duration  

Accuracy, speed and a clear, pleasant speaking voice are essential. If you already operate a call center or have access to a high-volume dialer, this should slot perfectly into your workflow. Once we’re up and running, the project can continue long-term.

• Show each tree’s Critical Root Zone and Structural Root Plate, with any encroachment from the proposed construction clearly hatched.  
• Draw the tree-save fence exactly at the disturbance boundary and include the municipality’s standard detail.  
• Identify trees slated for removal and, on the same sheet, lay out a replanting scheme that delivers a minimum of 4,000 sq ft of replacement canopy. Please list proposed species, caliper, spacing, and the canopy math used to reach the requirement.  

Scale should be 1" = 20', include a north arrow, legend, my permit number, and room for your professional seal. I will supply the latest survey base and GIS aerial once we start; field verification or a quick site walk together is welcome if you need it. Final deliverables are one print-ready PDF and the editable CAD file.

title: Ct to Viral Expression Conversion
desc:
I have an Excel spreadsheet that contains raw Cycle threshold (Ct) values for both the Citrus yellow vein clearing virus target sequence and my chosen housekeeping gene, Nad5. I need those Ct data converted into meaningful viral expression values so I can compare virus titres across my plant samples.

What I’m after is a clean, well-documented workflow that takes the raw Ct numbers, normalises them against Nad5, and outputs relative expression (e.g., 2^-ΔΔCt or similar) for each sample. Please include an ANOVA so I can see whether titre differences among my treatment groups are statistically significant; if you believe another test would add value, feel free to flag it, but ANOVA results are required.

Deliverables  
• A processed spreadsheet (or CSV) with ΔCt, ΔΔCt and final relative expression columns  
• A short methods write-up explaining formulas, software, and any assumptions  
• ANOVA summary table and a simple plot visualising group differences  
• Optional: a small script (R, Python or Excel macro) so I can rerun the analysis on future data
Graphs or tables for scientific publication. 

Accuracy and transparency are crucial—I will double-check calculations, so please leave the formulas visible or fully commented. If anything in my raw file needs cleaning or clarification, let me know early so we keep the turnaround quick.

title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Expert
desc:

I am looking for an experienced freelancer to assist with medical systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in medical/clinical research and previous experience conducting and publishing systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

Required skills:

* Systematic literature searching and study screening
* Data extraction from clinical studies/RCTs
* Risk-of-bias assessment (e.g., RoB 2, ROBINS-I)
* Conventional pairwise meta-analysis
* Statistical analysis using R, Stata, RevMan, or similar software
* Assessment of heterogeneity, publication bias, and sensitivity analyses
* Preparation of forest plots, funnel plots, and publication-quality figures/tables
* Familiarity with PRISMA guidelines
* Scientific/medical manuscript writing and interpretation of results

Experience with network meta-analysis, meta-regression, GRADE, and PROSPERO protocols would be an advantage.

This may involve multiple projects, so I am particularly interested in finding someone reliable for potential long-term collaboration.

When applying, please provide:

1. Your academic/research background
2. Your experience with medical meta-analyses
3. Examples or links to published meta-analyses you have worked on
4. Statistical software you use
5. Your availability and expected rate

Please apply only if you have genuine experience with medical systematic reviews and meta-analysis.

title: Automate Excel Form Submission

title: Design Arabic Prep Science Exam
desc:
I need a full-length, two-hour science exam written completely in Arabic for third-year preparatory students. The test must align with the national curriculum and focus solely on Physics and Biology.  

Deliverables I expect  
• A professionally formatted exam paper ready for printing  
• A separate answer key with a clear marking scheme  
• Editable source file (Word or Google Docs) and a clean PDF  

Please ensure questions reflect the depth and style typically seen in end-of-term assessments for this grade. If you have crafted similar exams before, feel free to mention it when you send your proposal.
